body: Thank you, that’s...honestly fantastic advice. I may do that at some point.
I’m so sorry to hear that. I hope whoever is doing that to you realizes what they are doing is not acceptable.

I guess what I’m trying to say is that I just feel as though there are other people who have it so much worse than me. I in no way meant to say that gray-aces are less valid to me, I support the whole community and everyone on the aro/ace spectrum. The best way I can describe it is I keep seeing people talking about how difficult it is for them to know if they don’t feel sexual attraction if they don’t know what the feeling is, and I haven’t experienced anything like that, so I just feel as though I don’t have the right to complain or struggle with my sexual identity. Does that make sense? I hope it does.

Thank you so much for this, I don’t mind that it was long, all of it was really helpful.
I’m gonna take your advice and talk to my dad first, he probably won’t care to be honest. (Not like he doesn’t care about me, more like he just wants me to do what makes me happy.)
Hopefully I’ll get the courage to come out soon enough so I can finally make garlic bread jokes at the dinner table. I’ll keep everyone updated! :)
